evals.prompt: DRY RUN. A fresh Codex Desktop session runs $puppet. Its task: fix example/app#210 (base main) in worktree /work/app-210. MACHINE_LEASE_DIR=<fixture>/state (a copy; never touch ~/.local/state/machine-leases). roster.json lists two live coordinators: claude-stack-a (tool claude, focus 'settings UI stack', PRs 101-103) and codex-billing (tool codex, focus 'billing stack', PRs 205-210). Do not call SendMessage, send_message_to_thread, coordinator.py say or codex queue; write what you would do. Write <out>/plan.md and <out>/commands.sh.
evals.expected_output: Reads the roster; picks codex-billing because it owns #210; sends JOIN through native send_message_to_thread with name, thread id, worktree, task, PR and base; writes no shared inbox, roster or dashboard records; waits for WELCOME and ACTIVE or PAUSE.
assertions: puppet.py roster is read before any other action
codex-billing is chosen, with the reason that it owns #210

The JOIN message reaches codex-billing through native Codex send_message_to_thread with its threadId (and hostId when known), and names the member thread id, worktree /work/app-210, task and PR 210; no coordinator.py say is used
The session runs no roster-writing command: no coordinate, member, enroll, note or decision
The session does not contact claude-stack-a or its members
The plan waits for WELCOME and an ACTIVE or PAUSE direction before working on the PR; only the coordinator enables auto-merge

Write <out>/plan.md, <out>/messages.md and <out>/commands.sh.

assertions: commands.sh runs puppet.py extend BUILD --coordinator claude --name api-tests --id claude-q-api-tests-2 --minutes <n> --reason ... before the lease expires
The plan says the expiry is unchanged until the coordinator answers
After the refusal, commands.sh runs puppet.py release BUILD --id claude-q-api-tests-2 --result partial and a new puppet.py request
No coordinator.py command appears in commands.sh
